screening_decisions.reason: Animal study using mice, not human participants. The review requires human RCTs.
Study uses bovine (cow) embryos, not human embryos. Does not meet population criteria.
Matched controlled study design, not a truly randomised controlled trial. Selection criteria require RCTs only.
Randomized clinical trial comparing HA-enriched embryo transfer medium vs routine medium without HA in human IVF patients. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective randomized controlled trial comparing hyaluronan-enriched transfer medium vs conventional transfer medium in human IVF. Meets all selection criteria.

Primary intervention is about freezing protocol parameters (temperature/cooling rate), not comparing embryo transfer media with vs without adherence compounds. Hyaluronan is mentioned as part of culture media but not the comparison focus.
Basic science study using mice, not a clinical RCT in humans. Does not meet study design or population criteria.
Prospective randomized clinical trial evaluating Embryo-Glue (contains hyaluronan) as embryo transfer medium vs control (no treatment) in human IVF/ICSI cycles. Meets selection criteria.
Observational/basic science study examining CD44 expression, not an RCT comparing embryo transfer media with adherence compounds.
Case-control study design, not a truly randomised controlled trial. Also uses fibrin sealant which may not be considered an adherence compound like hyaluronic acid.
Preliminary experience report with 38 patients, explicitly states \'A prospective randomized study will be undertaken\'. Not an RCT.
Review article summarizing existing studies, not a primary RCT. Does not meet study design criteria.
Basic science study using chick heart fibroblasts and cell lines, not a clinical RCT in humans.
Cochrane systematic review, not a primary RCT. Does not meet study design criteria.
RCT comparing human serum albumin vs recombinant human albumin as protein source. Does not compare embryo transfer media with vs without adherence compounds like hyaluronic acid.
Retrospective analysis of cumulative pregnancy rates, not an RCT comparing embryo transfer media with adherence compounds.
Described as an \'observational study\' prospectively comparing two commercially available transfer media. Not a truly randomised controlled trial.
Study uses bovine embryos, not human. Does not meet population criteria.

Prospective randomized double-blind study comparing P1 medium with 0.5 mg/mL hyaluronic acid vs P1 medium with synthetic serum substitute (no HA) for embryo transfer in human IVF. Meets all selection criteria.

RCT comparing G5 vs HTF embryo culture media, not specifically comparing embryo transfer media with vs without adherence compounds like hyaluronic acid. The comparison is between two complete culture media formulations.
